package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseWindowedSubsecondValues(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-windowed-discovery"
	all := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(102, "subsecond-service", "fractional", 1, 0, 20_500_000_000, 20_900_000_000)}}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/subsecond-input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, all.ResourceSpans[0].ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, all, nil)
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, []*Trace{row})
	tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier("name")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	values := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
	collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { values = append(values, &v); return false })
	if err = block.SearchTagValuesV2(context.Background(), tag, collect, func(uint64) {}, common.DefaultSearchOptions()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(values) != 1 || values[0].Value != "fractional" {
		t.Fatal(values)
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(dir + "/subsecond-routing.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type Case struct {
		Start    int64                              `json:"start"`
		End      int64                              `json:"end"`
		Included bool                               `json:"included"`
		Response *tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := range cases {
		cases[i].Response = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
		if cases[i].Included {
			cases[i].Response.TagValues = values
		}
	}
	raw, err = json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/subsecond-oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestPulseWindowedEnvelopes(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-windowed-discovery"
	for _, prefix := range []string{"", "subsecond-"} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(dir + "/" + prefix + "oracle.json")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var cases []struct {
			Response *tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response `json:"response"`
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for i, c := range cases {
			for _, v := range []int{1, 2} {
				wire, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%sresult-%d-%02d.protobuf", dir, prefix, v, i))
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if v == 2 {
					got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
					if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if !proto.Equal(got, c.Response) {
						t.Fatal(got, c.Response)
					}
				} else {
					values := []string{}
					for _, value := range c.Response.TagValues {
						values = append(values, value.Value)
					}
					sort.Strings(values)
					got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{}
					if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{TagValues: values}) {
						t.Fatal(got, values)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
